messages.ability.assassin-e.description: 向瞄準點瞬移，短暫免傷并攻擊附近敵人。
messages.ability.assassin-e.name: 暗影步
messages.ability.assassin-q.description: 新瞄準的攻擊無法鎖定你，已有危險仍會造成傷害。
messages.ability.assassin-q.name: 隱身
messages.ability.assassin-ultimate.description: 持續 5 秒獲得三次免費的強化暗影步、100% 暴擊率，且無法被新瞄準的攻擊鎖定。已有危險在閃避無敵之外仍有效。
messages.ability.assassin-ultimate.name: 未書之路
messages.ability.engineer-e.description: 部署擁有 120 生命的擋彈屏障，隊友可穿過。
messages.ability.engineer-e.name: 可部署路障
messages.ability.engineer-q.description: 部署擁有 80 生命、每秒基礎傷害 25 的砲塔。
messages.ability.engineer-q.name: 鉚釘砲塔
messages.ability.engineer-ultimate.description: 部署擁有 200 生命、每秒基礎傷害 90 的攻城裝置，持續 14 秒；自有砲塔輸出提高 50%。
messages.ability.engineer-ultimate.name: 不可能的機器
messages.ability.heavy-e.description: 持續 5 秒獲得 45% 傷害抗性與 30% 射速，但移速降至 60%。
messages.ability.heavy-e.name: 穩固射擊
messages.ability.heavy-q.description: 以扇形射出十四發子彈，使普通敵人減速 40%。
messages.ability.heavy-q.name: 扇形壓制
messages.ability.heavy-ultimate.description: 持續 6 秒獲得 70% 射速、額外兩次穿透且不消耗彈匣，移動速度降低。
messages.ability.heavy-ultimate.name: 鑄造廠序曲
messages.ability.mage-e.description: 引爆瞄準點的結界，為附近友軍提供 35 護盾。
messages.ability.mage-e.name: 結界引爆
messages.ability.mage-q.description: 傷害法印內敵人，使普通敵人減速 55%。
messages.ability.mage-q.name: 束縛法印
messages.ability.mage-ultimate.description: 在 3 秒內釋放三次各 120 傷害的脈沖。首次脈沖清除范圍內敵彈，并大幅減速普通敵人。
messages.ability.mage-ultimate.name: 無聲第十二響
messages.ability.medic-e.description: 為附近友軍恢復 20 點生命，并移除中毒與減速。
messages.ability.medic-e.name: 凈化血清
messages.ability.medic-q.description: 每秒為領域內友軍恢復 8 點生命。
messages.ability.medic-q.name: 治療領域
messages.ability.medic-ultimate.description: 引導一秒後，按所選難度的復活規則救起附近倒地或淘汰的隊友。為存活隊友治療40點、淨化效果，並對附近敵人造成35點傷害。單人還獲得40點護盾。
messages.ability.medic-ultimate.name: 姓名歸還
messages.ability.soldier-e.description: 向瞄準點射出三發精準穿透彈。
messages.ability.soldier-e.name: 精準連射
messages.ability.soldier-q.description: 領域內友軍獲得 20% 武器傷害和 10% 移速加成。
messages.ability.soldier-q.name: 集結領域
messages.ability.soldier-ultimate.description: 立即為友軍換彈，一次性清除附近敵彈，并使領域內友軍在 8 秒內獲得 35% 武器傷害加成。
messages.ability.soldier-ultimate.name: 最后點名
messages.ability.tank-e.description: 向瞄準點沖鋒，短暫免傷并攻擊附近敵人。
messages.ability.tank-e.name: 救援沖鋒
messages.ability.tank-q.description: 部署擁有 150 生命的擋彈墻，友軍可穿過。
messages.ability.tank-q.name: 防護墻
messages.ability.tank-ultimate.description: 附近友軍在 8 秒內獲得 120 護盾和 35 個百分點的護甲加成。遵循全局上限，同類領域不疊加。
messages.ability.tank-ultimate.name: 城池不倒
messages.arena.bell-foundry.description: 冰冷銅鐘與巨型模具形成掩體群，設有四條寬闊出口。
messages.arena.bell-foundry.name: 鐘鑄工廠
messages.arena.crown-crypt.description: 空響鐘群下被淹沒的議事廳，外圍環道開闊。
messages.arena.crown-crypt.name: 王冠地窖
messages.arena.gatehouse.description: 破損城門與干涸噴泉，外墻通道寬闊。
messages.arena.gatehouse.name: 城門樓
messages.arena.ossuary-works.description: 殯葬機械與骨箱分隔出對角射擊通道。
messages.arena.ossuary-works.name: 骨堂工坊
messages.arena.sunken-chapel.description: 洪水圍繞石道與裂開的祭壇，水域邊界有明確標記。
messages.arena.sunken-chapel.name: 沉沒禮拜堂
messages.arena.triage-yard.description: 廢棄病院帳篷與靜默病床，救援路線寬闊。
messages.arena.triage-yard.name: 分診庭院
messages.attack.armor.description: 短暫提高傷害抗性，將爆發攻擊留給隨后的破綻。
messages.attack.armor.name: 裝甲姿態
messages.attack.beam.description: 標記線在預警后變為傷害光束。
messages.attack.beam.name: 光束
messages.attack.charge.description: 首領在預警后沿標記路線沖刺。
messages.attack.charge.name: 沖鋒
messages.attack.cross.description: 交錯的彈丸通道掃過場地。
messages.attack.cross.name: 交叉彈道
messages.attack.fan.description: 瞄準彈丸以扇形射出，在開火前離開標記錐形區域。
messages.attack.fan.name: 扇形齊射
messages.attack.hook.description: 定向鉤索威脅落單幸存者，避開標記路線。
messages.attack.hook.name: 鉤索
messages.attack.lanes.description: 平行彈道之間交替出現安全路徑。
messages.attack.lanes.name: 彈幕通道
messages.attack.pool.description: 標記地面變為持續傷害區域。
messages.attack.pool.name: 污染池
messages.attack.pulse.description: 首領釋放近距離衝擊，移出標記半徑。
messages.attack.pulse.name: 衝擊脈衝
messages.attack.ring.description: 彈丸從首領向外擴散，利用可見缺口或及時閃避。
messages.attack.ring.name: 擴散彈環
messages.attack.spiral.description: 旋轉彈流之間留有移動逃生路線。
messages.attack.spiral.name: 螺旋
messages.attack.summon.description: 地面預警后出現額外敵人。
messages.attack.summon.name: 召喚
messages.attack.tether.description: 連結迫使小隊協調移動并幫助被困隊友。
messages.attack.tether.name: 束縛
messages.attack.warp.description: 首領在預警后變換位置，注意目標地點。
messages.attack.warp.name: 瞬移
messages.attack.zone.description: 標記區域將變為傷害拘捕區，在預警結束前離開。
messages.attack.zone.name: 拘捕區域
messages.boss.alchemist.brutalHelp: Brutal會連接同種藥液，造成兩次定時噴發。第一次噴發前中和任意一處積液，即可取消兩次噴發。
messages.boss.alchemist.crazedHelp: Crazed保留紫色催化劑：冷卻液將其淬滅並被消耗，未混合的試劑則在新的預警後爆發。此外會部署蒸餾柱。第一階段：一根柱沿固定路徑釋放兩團霧。第二階段：三團霧在各次預警間重新瞄準。第三階段：兩根柱各釋放兩團霧。第四階段：各三團，最後一團向蒸餾柱回流。每條霧路都有1.8秒預警。霧氣越過磚石，每團只命中一次，並使人減速。引導酸和鹼在柱旁混合，冷卻柱體可停止後續及尚未釋放的霧；已經釋放的霧仍會移動。冷卻液碰到霧會使其凝結，隨後冷卻液在0.9秒寬限後耗盡。蒸餾柱無法射毀，也要為其他化學反應留出空間。
messages.boss.alchemist.description: 燒瓶瞄準倖存者，並預警落點1.4秒。酸與鹼都會傷害並減速。混合可清除藥液，生成能吸收蒸氣、冷卻容器的冷卻液。它是反應產物，不是拾取物。
messages.boss.alchemist.name: 霉菌煉金師
messages.boss.alchemist.phaseHint.0: 琥珀色三角是酸，藍色方塊是鹼。把相反藥液的投擲引到積液旁再離開，混合後會生成淺色冷卻液。
messages.boss.alchemist.phaseHint.1: 蒸氣會橫穿戰場。衝刺穿過蒸氣帶，或利用冷卻液；蒸氣會在冷卻液周圍讓開。
messages.boss.alchemist.phaseHint.2: 壓力容器會在破裂前膨脹。在旁邊製造冷卻液，趕在標記的爆炸前將它冷卻。
messages.boss.alchemist.phaseHint.3: 兩道蒸氣帶依序通過，每道都有新的預警。冷卻容器，並為每道蒸氣保留通路。
messages.boss.anatomist.description: 卡尺延遲攻擊兩個已鎖定位置。鎖定圖示變化後離開固定圓圈。
messages.boss.anatomist.name: 解剖學家
messages.boss.ash-baker.brutalHelp: 殘暴形態在 4.3 秒後預警第二批，鎖定當時可見的倖存者。每次滾動與碎屑都有完整預警。
messages.boss.ash-baker.crazedHelp: 瘋狂形態還會在 7.2 秒後預警第三批。每批最多命中你一次；擊碎硬殼只會取消它自己的碎屑。
messages.boss.ash-baker.description: 一個麵包在完整預警後沿鎖定路線滾動。離開麵包實體的路線；線條本身不會造成傷害。 三個麵包鋪開路線。落地後的硬殼可在碎屑計時結束前射碎。 五個麵包落地，再預警四向碎屑。擊碎硬殼，或沿新路線之間的空隙移動。
messages.boss.ash-baker.lore: 議會還沒把麵粉算成爐料時，艾達·馬爾就為夜班烤麵包。她用另一本帳簿給封鎖線外的人分食，記錄份數而非債務。保持烤爐熾熱的命令活得比她更久。她胸中的烤爐依然按等待者的名字數量衡量每一批。
messages.boss.ash-baker.name: 灰燼麵包師
messages.boss.ash-baker.phaseHint.0: 一個麵包在完整預警後沿鎖定路線滾動。離開麵包實體的路線；線條本身不會造成傷害。
messages.boss.ash-baker.phaseHint.1: 三個麵包鋪開路線。落地後的硬殼可在碎屑計時結束前射碎。
messages.boss.ash-baker.phaseHint.2: 五個麵包落地，再預警四向碎屑。擊碎硬殼，或沿新路線之間的空隙移動。
messages.boss.ash-baker.phaseHint.3: 四個側翼麵包讓出中央，隨後預警三向碎屑。橫穿前看清新的中央路線。
messages.boss.ashen-usher.brutalHelp: 殘酷形態會在目標後方增設票架，並延遲補射。
messages.boss.ashen-usher.description: 票架會按鎖定方向齊射。擊破票架，或等子彈通過後穿行。後續階段會交叉射擊並再次掃射。
messages.boss.ashen-usher.name: 灰燼引座員
messages.boss.bell-triplets.description: 三個守鐘人輪流施法。攻擊醒目施法者可打斷光束，未打斷也始終有安全缺口。
messages.boss.bell-triplets.name: 鐘聲三胞胎
messages.boss.bellringer.brutalHelp: Brutal在重疊聲波中加入一次鏈式鐘舌投擲。離開標記的投擲路線。鐘舌落地後，在新的回收預警期間，白色裂紋頭部可以被射擊；擊碎它可阻止回收，否則要避開返回的頭部。細鏈本身無害。
messages.boss.bellringer.crazedHelp: Crazed繼承投擲鐘舌，頭部更耐打，並在主鐘持續攻擊時部署第二口鐘。三或四道回應聲波及獨立鐘舌揮擊與主鐘重疊。分辨各個聲源和固定缺口，在重新瞄準的攻擊之間保持移動。
messages.boss.bellringer.description: 標準形態的聲波保留固定46度缺口，強化形態為35度。讓整個身體處於缺口內，或衝刺越過波前。淺色接近路線無害，每道移動聲波和鐘舌揮擊只命中一次。
messages.boss.bellringer.name: 敲鐘人
messages.boss.bellringer.phaseHint.0: 預警的鐘舌揮擊後，兩道外擴波重疊。先離開標記扇區，再觀察兩道波前。
messages.boss.bellringer.phaseHint.1: 敲鐘人先接近倖存者，再放出三道波和兩次瞄準揮擊。淺色接近路線無害，攻擊在到達後鎖定。
messages.boss.bellringer.phaseHint.2: 外擴波與內收的回擊重疊。看方向箭頭和固定缺口；每次鐘舌揮擊在獨立預警時鎖定瞄準。
messages.boss.bellringer.phaseHint.3: 六道交替聲波和三次鐘舌揮擊組成連奏。在分別預警的攻擊之間保持移動。
messages.boss.black-ambulance.brutalHelp: 殘酷在兩個階段分別出車2/3次。每次停車都提前至少1.25秒預警有缺口的車門彈幕，實際發射40發。出車前觀察剩餘波次標記。
messages.boss.black-ambulance.crazedHelp: 狂亂保留殘酷機制，後半階段增加第4次出車，每次停車發射120發並追加交叉波次。每條新車道仍完整預警。
messages.boss.black-ambulance.description: 救護車沿可通行的外圈移動後，沿固定車道衝鋒。金色巡行線無害，寬車道在衝鋒開始後危險。掩體與實際場地邊界限制車身。最後出車後車夫暴露3秒，首領承受額外25%傷害。
messages.boss.black-ambulance.name: 黑色救護車
messages.boss.black-ambulance.phaseHint.0: 觀察金色巡行標記。衝鋒前離開鎖定車道。最後停車3秒時攻擊車夫，對首領傷害+25%。
messages.boss.black-ambulance.phaseHint.1: 後半階段反向巡行並連續出車兩次。每條新車道都會完整預警。等待最後車夫暴露。
messages.boss.boiler-tender.description: 三個閥門積蓄壓力。站住任一中立閥門可打開安全扇區，也可走標記外圍缺口。
messages.boss.boiler-tender.name: 鍋爐看守
messages.boss.brass-toad.brutalHelp: 殘酷形態每次落地後追加延遲漣漪；最終階段連續跳躍三次。
messages.boss.brass-toad.description: 離開標記的落點，再穿過漣漪缺口。後續階段增加第二次跳躍與鎖定的舌擊通道。擊破排水塞可阻止舌擊。
messages.boss.brass-toad.name: 黃銅蟾蜍
messages.boss.bridge-ferryman.description: 兩座臨時橋交替跨越危險水帶。沿開放箭頭通行，或走安全外圍繞道。
messages.boss.bridge-ferryman.name: 橋樑擺渡人
messages.boss.canal-diver.description: 潛入三處水窪，從最先冒泡的一處浮出。避開擴散圈，在浮出後的恢復期攻擊。
messages.boss.canal-diver.name: 運河潛水員
messages.boss.candle-snail.brutalHelp: 殘酷形態追加延遲橫切蠟道，並連續發射兩波有預警的彈幕。
messages.boss.candle-snail.description: 在蠟道燃燒前離開標記。石牆會截斷蠟道。 兩條蠟道之間留有安全中央通道；蝸牛滑行更快。
messages.boss.candle-snail.name: 燭蝸牛
messages.boss.candle-snail.phaseHint.0: 在蠟道燃燒前離開標記。石牆會截斷蠟道。
messages.boss.candle-snail.phaseHint.1: 兩條蠟道之間留有安全中央通道；蝸牛滑行更快。
messages.boss.chain-colossus.description: 三個柱點拉動標記地面。擊破任一個可製造輸出窗口，也可沿暢通外圍移動。
messages.boss.chain-colossus.name: 鎖鏈巨像
messages.boss.chain-marshal.brutalHelp: 殘酷會讓每個存活錨點發射帶缺口的尖刺彈幕。切斷一個錨點可取消其回掃與未發射的重複彈；已飛出的子彈仍危險。趁明確的恢復期進攻。
messages.boss.chain-marshal.crazedHelp: 狂亂保留殘酷機制，尖刺彈量為其三倍。後續重複波加入單獨預警的交叉角度，逐次觀察預警。
messages.boss.chain-marshal.description: 兩個編號錨點預警方向相反且鎖定的掃擊。離開塗色扇區、從掃過的鎖鏈後方穿越，或擊碎錨點切斷對應鎖鏈。實心牆體會擋住鎖鏈。
messages.boss.chain-marshal.name: 鎖鏈元帥
messages.boss.chain-marshal.phaseHint.0: 第一輪掃擊會鎖定方向。尖刺彈幕的缺口不能防住鎖鏈本體。
messages.boss.chain-marshal.phaseHint.1: 按預警移動後，兩條鎖鏈依次啟動。每個存活錨點都會重新瞄準並完整預警反向掃擊；穿越前看清新扇區。
messages.boss.chalk-magistrate.description: 矩形三面牆將閃擊，一面先被擦除。預警時從擦除面離開；牆體不會以碰撞困住玩家。
messages.boss.chalk-magistrate.name: 粉筆裁判官
messages.boss.choir-of-moths.description: 三條彎曲蛾帶中有一處明確斷口。從斷口橫穿，不要穿過完整蛾帶。
messages.boss.choir-of-moths.name: 飛蛾合唱團
messages.boss.choir.description: 亡者歌手協調光束與交叉攻擊，在預警變為危險前移動。
messages.boss.choir.name: 墓地合唱團
messages.boss.cinder-foreman.description: 三個工區準備噴氣。使用中立冷卻開關，或前往天然安全的第三扇區。
messages.boss.cinder-foreman.name: 餘燼工頭
messages.boss.city-eater.description: 兩條咬擊路線之間留有寬逃生道。走未標記通道並在恢復期輸出，打破臨時牆可暴露核心。
messages.boss.city-eater.name: 吞城者
messages.boss.clockmender.description: 慢速彈環暫停後沿原方向恢復。趁靜止穿過，在三拍提示結束前離開。
messages.boss.clockmender.name: 修鐘匠
messages.boss.cobble-crab.brutalHelp: 殘酷形態增設獨立錨石、額外夾擊及兩波彈幕。
messages.boss.cobble-crab.description: 離開標記的合攏石鉗，或擊破與其相連的錨石。 石鉗交替方向並合攏兩次。錨石可取消相連的兩次夾擊。
messages.boss.cobble-crab.name: 卵石蟹
messages.boss.cobble-crab.phaseHint.0: 離開標記的合攏石鉗，或擊破與其相連的錨石。
messages.boss.cobble-crab.phaseHint.1: 石鉗交替方向並合攏兩次。錨石可取消相連的兩次夾擊。
messages.boss.constable.description: 死去的守衛隊長發射瞄準齊射與包圍彈環，留意標記的拘捕區域。
messages.boss.constable.name: 空殼警長
messages.boss.courier.brutalHelp: 進階形態增加一次衝鋒和延遲扇形齊射。每段都有完整預警，扇形中央留有標記缺口。
messages.boss.courier.description: 半血後，單次投遞變為兩次衝鋒。橫向避開固定路線，繞過消退的軌跡，趁最終停頓反擊。
messages.boss.courier.name: 腐肉信使
messages.boss.courier.phaseHint.0: 橫向躲開固定衝鋒路線，趁停頓反擊。信使身後的狹窄軌跡會逐漸消退。
messages.boss.courier.phaseHint.1: 第二次衝鋒從第一次停下的位置發出預警。看清每個新箭頭，最後一次投遞後再進攻。
messages.boss.crow-shepherd.description: 三隊鳥群沿交叉路徑飛行。看清虛線路線，從領頭鳥身後穿過。
messages.boss.crow-shepherd.name: 牧鴉人
messages.boss.crown-procession.description: 四名侍從抬著王座移動。擊倒任一個可讓王座落下，或在定時休息時攻擊。
messages.boss.crown-procession.name: 王冠巡遊
messages.boss.engine.description: 裝甲機器在齊射間關閉弱點，將爆發留給暴露階段。
messages.boss.engine.name: 殯葬引擎
messages.boss.folded-man.description: 地面摺線使彈丸鏡向反射一次。看清預測的入射與出射線，或待在不反射的一側。
messages.boss.folded-man.name: 摺疊人
messages.boss.gate-widow.brutalHelp: 殘酷會從開口兩側發射單獨預警、帶缺口的針彈。開口不是擋彈護盾。趁恢復期進攻。
messages.boss.gate-widow.crazedHelp: 狂亂保留殘酷機制，針彈量增至三倍，並增加交叉重複波及一道完整預警的門。
messages.boss.gate-widow.description: 兩條通道關閉，編號開口仍可通行。移動的地波沿兩條關閉通道掃過。進入開放通道，或抓準時機衝過地波。牆體無法阻擋地波。
messages.boss.gate-widow.name: 城門寡婦
messages.boss.gate-widow.phaseHint.0: 觀察鎖定的開口和地面箭頭。每道門預警1.5秒，地波再晚0.6秒開始。
messages.boss.gate-widow.phaseHint.1: 按標記移動後，直門與橫門分別預警。舊門全部打開後才開始下一方向。
messages.boss.glass-surgeon.brutalHelp: Brutal在第一次脈衝後發出有完整預警的第二次折射。碎裂的透鏡不會恢復。
messages.boss.glass-surgeon.crazedHelp: Crazed稍後增加獨立預警的切割，盡可能瞄準另一名倖存者。它會等回返脈衝結束。
messages.boss.glass-surgeon.description: 透鏡鎖定折射光線。虛線變為實線前離開，或擊碎透鏡。光線穿透掩體。 兩枚透鏡接力一條路徑。擊碎透鏡會切斷所有下游光段。每次脈衝只能命中你一次。 一枚透鏡向兩個可見位置分岔。預警出現時目標位置即鎖定；移動或擊碎共用透鏡。
messages.boss.glass-surgeon.lore: 奧倫·佩爾醫師為醫務所製作透鏡。議會命他按眼睛顏色評判病人，他砸碎了議會的測量玻璃。他的玻璃手臂仍在尋找不會成為判決的診斷。
messages.boss.glass-surgeon.name: 玻璃外科醫師
messages.boss.glass-surgeon.phaseHint.0: 透鏡鎖定折射光線。虛線變為實線前離開，或擊碎透鏡。光線穿透掩體。
messages.boss.glass-surgeon.phaseHint.1: 兩枚透鏡接力一條路徑。擊碎透鏡會切斷所有下游光段。每次脈衝只能命中你一次。
messages.boss.glass-surgeon.phaseHint.2: 一枚透鏡向兩個可見位置分岔。預警出現時目標位置即鎖定；移動或擊碎共用透鏡。
messages.boss.glass-surgeon.phaseHint.3: 第一次脈衝後，回返透鏡會改變出口。在安靜間隔中讀取下一條虛線路徑。
messages.boss.gravedigger.description: 移動土脊可擋敵彈，隨後塌成地坑。短暫借掩護，再離開標記塌陷路線。
messages.boss.gravedigger.name: 掘墓人
messages.boss.hourglass-widow.description: 慢速扇彈在倒數後沿原路徑重播一次。看清虛線預告，或留在固定安全側翼。
messages.boss.hourglass-widow.name: 沙漏寡婦
messages.boss.ice-custodian.description: 三條冰帶造成有限的側向滑動。走乾燥條帶；正常閃避仍然可用。
messages.boss.ice-custodian.name: 寒冰保管員
messages.boss.ink-notary.description: 未閉合的墨水螺旋會硬化為危險。啟動前從開口出去，不要橫穿筆畫。
messages.boss.ink-notary.name: 墨水公證人
messages.boss.lamplighter.brutalHelp: 殘暴形態在最後一輪既定守夜的6秒後追加新一輪，帶來新蠟燭與完整預警，並保留發起時的階段。
messages.boss.lamplighter.crazedHelp: 瘋狂形態在4.8秒後再加一輪。脈衝期間穿越裸露間隙，即使兩端安全也可能受傷。新恢復行動者從下一次完整預警開始受判定。
messages.boss.lamplighter.description: 三支蠟燭標出可以抵達的輪廓庇護區。在2.8秒預警結束前到達目的地。影子只阻擋燈光脈衝，不能阻擋熔岩。 影子在預警期間移動，並在危險開始前停下。射擊標記相同的蠟燭，可固定並擴大它預告的目的地。 兩輪完整預警的守夜相隔4.8秒。後續庇護區依倖存者目前位置生成；每道脈衝最多命中你一次。
messages.boss.lamplighter.lore: 塔文·奧爾檢查洛恩的街燈，並簽字認可每街三盞燈的標準。夜班護士拿來燈間死角的草圖，他卻將其歸檔為對黑暗的抱怨。最後一次巡查時，他把一盞燈移到通往醫館的路上，卻在報告裡寫下獲批的間距。他的梯子仍按那條他只敢私下變通的規矩提供庇護。
messages.boss.lamplighter.name: 點燈人
messages.boss.lamplighter.phaseHint.0: 三支蠟燭標出可以抵達的輪廓庇護區。在2.8秒預警結束前到達目的地。影子只阻擋燈光脈衝，不能阻擋熔岩。
messages.boss.lamplighter.phaseHint.1: 影子在預警期間移動，並在危險開始前停下。射擊標記相同的蠟燭，可固定並擴大它預告的目的地。
messages.boss.lamplighter.phaseHint.2: 兩輪完整預警的守夜相隔4.8秒。後續庇護區依倖存者目前位置生成；每道脈衝最多命中你一次。
messages.boss.lamplighter.phaseHint.3: 三輪守夜交替改變方向，庇護區也更小。標記將蠟燭與庇護區對應；擊碎一支不會改變其他蠟燭的庇護區。
messages.boss.lantern-warden.brutalHelp: 殘酷形態交替掃射方向，並重複恢復期齊射。最終階段增加有完整預警的回掃；危險掃射不會重疊。
messages.boss.lantern-warden.description: 看清掃射箭頭，留在光錐後方。半血後守衛在掃射間巡行，危險光錐的地面起點保持鎖定。
messages.boss.lantern-warden.name: 提燈守衛
messages.boss.lantern-warden.phaseHint.0: 沿箭頭移到光錐後方。預警與掃射期間，守衛保持不動。
messages.boss.lantern-warden.phaseHint.1: 守衛會在下一次預警前巡行。認清新的地面起點，再移到光錐後方。
messages.boss.last-breath-saint.description: 輕微吸力後釋放慢速呼氣彈環。利用任一避難踏板或向外移動，單人只需一個踏板。
messages.boss.last-breath-saint.name: 最後呼吸之聖
messages.boss.last-knocker.description: 三次可見叩擊後，門體掃過標記扇區。移動到鉸鏈後方，在門打開的恢復期攻擊。
messages.boss.last-knocker.name: 最後叩門者
messages.boss.ledger-leech.description: 紙封印使目標減速。穿過任一淨化圈或等減速結束；不會偷走貨幣。
messages.boss.ledger-leech.name: 帳本水蛭
messages.boss.matron.brutalHelp: Brutal中每個唱出波紋的巢穴增加30枚預警針彈，左右交替發射並保留中央缺口。所有方向提前顯示。
messages.boss.matron.crazedHelp: Crazed保留Brutal的前30枚針彈，並以額外交叉連射增至每巢90枚。注意紫色射線與剩餘波次標記。
messages.boss.matron.description: 育嬰女監沿避開障礙的路線走向標記巢穴。最多三個巢穴在1.2秒預警後召出數量受限的幼屍。摧毀巢穴可取消之後的召喚與未發射的針。前期由新巢唱出波紋；後期由存活巢穴輪唱，每道波紋預警1.6秒。若無巢存活，則由女監獨唱。穿過可見缺口；已發出的波紋不會消失。
messages.boss.matron.name: 搖籃主母
messages.boss.matron.phaseHint.0: 看清淺色護送路線與新巢預警。從缺口穿過搖籃曲；摧毀巢穴可阻止幼屍出現。
messages.boss.matron.phaseHint.1: 存活巢穴按編號輪流唱出波紋。缺口在釋放前固定。後期每批由兩隻幼屍增至四隻。
messages.boss.memory-taxer.description: 脈衝前展示三個安全踏板符號。按介面保留的歷史選擇首個符號，無須強記。
messages.boss.memory-taxer.name: 記憶徵稅官
messages.boss.mirror-undertaker.description: 無害倒影複製先前位置。透過腳下黑色標記辨認真身，忽略空心倒影輪廓。
messages.boss.mirror-undertaker.name: 鏡面殯葬師
messages.boss.mourning-kettle.brutalHelp: 殘酷形態追加延遲後方噴汽及兩波水珠。保留一條冷卻路線。
messages.boss.mourning-kettle.description: 在蒸汽預警時向側面移動。蒸汽結束後水珠橫穿；擊破閥門可取消對應傾注。 兩條分開的通道依次噴汽，中央保持冷卻。
messages.boss.mourning-kettle.name: 哀悼茶壺
messages.boss.mourning-kettle.phaseHint.0: 在蒸汽預警時向側面移動。蒸汽結束後水珠橫穿；擊破閥門可取消對應傾注。
messages.boss.mourning-kettle.phaseHint.1: 兩條分開的通道依次噴汽，中央保持冷卻。
messages.boss.ossuary-leviathan.description: 三根肋骨依編號先後暴露弱點。集火暴露肋骨，避開粗線身體輪廓。
messages.boss.ossuary-leviathan.name: 骨堂利維坦
messages.boss.pallbearer.description: 背棺巨人披甲沖鋒，利用移動掩體并抓住破綻進攻。
messages.boss.pallbearer.name: 抬棺者
messages.boss.plague-gardener.description: 四條放射藤蔓生長後，一條會切開成為治療小徑。走小徑，或擊破根部縮短生長期。
messages.boss.plague-gardener.name: 瘟疫園丁
messages.boss.porcelain-mourner.description: 四塊面具碎片先作移動掩體，再碎裂成放射攻擊。出現開裂預警就遠離。
messages.boss.porcelain-mourner.name: 瓷面哀悼者
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.advancedDescriptio: 殘酷在第一階段開始時隨機選擇I–V中的一個綠色編號，並在整個階段保持不變。狂亂每組印記都重選綠色編號。進入前先看缺口標記。 後期按標記巡遊後，每組進階印記會鎖定新的隨機綠色編號。觀察新的缺口標記。
殘酷在第一階段開始時隨機選擇I–V中的一個綠色編號，並在整個階段保持不變。狂亂每組印記都重選綠色編號。進入前先看缺口標記。
後期按標記巡遊後，每組進階印記會鎖定新的隨機綠色編號。觀察新的缺口標記。
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.brutalHelp: 殘酷有五個印記。綠色庇護至少持續3.5秒，並涵蓋最後一輪預警回響抵達邊緣的時間。 紫色三角的撞擊傷害是紅色的兩倍。每個印記首次命中還會無視護甲與護盾扣除目前生命的15%，並施加3秒中毒（每半秒2點基礎傷害）與35%步行減速。中毒只刷新、不疊加；淨化可移除。綠色庇護與無敵可阻止施加及毒傷，衝刺速度不變。
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.crazedHelp: 狂亂有十個印記。綠色庇護至少持續5秒，涵蓋最後的預警回響。黑色骷髏每個印記每次啟動僅扣除一次目前生命的75%，無視護甲與護盾，至少留下1點生命。 紫色三角的撞擊傷害是紅色的兩倍。每個印記首次命中還會無視護甲與護盾扣除目前生命的15%，並施加3秒中毒（每半秒2點基礎傷害）與35%步行減速。中毒只刷新、不疊加；淨化可移除。綠色庇護與無敵可阻止施加及毒傷，衝刺速度不變。
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.description: 三個有序印記落在可達空地上。序列結束後，帶缺口的印記重新開放：前半場為I，後半場為短暫延遲後的III。等變綠再進入。 綠色護盾會擋住兩個紅色印記預警後的彈幕，讓你繼續射擊。子彈會在邊緣碎裂，外圈逐漸縮短，表示保護即將結束。你也可以在圈外閃避。
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.domainHelp: 狂亂第二階段每組印記留下兩個琥珀色無限領域。單獨預警2秒後持續至戰鬥結束。每次接觸穿透護甲與護盾，扣除最大生命值10%，可使你倒地。每位倖存者所有領域共用每秒一次命中。綠色庇護與無敵可保護。
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.name: 隔離書記官
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.phaseHint.0: 按順序看清印記I、II、III。III落下後，進入帶缺口的第一個印記的綠色內部。 綠色護盾會擋住兩個紅色印記預警後的彈幕，讓你繼續射擊。子彈會在邊緣碎裂，外圈逐漸縮短，表示保護即將結束。你也可以在圈外閃避。
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.phaseHint.1: 書記員先移動再標記。避開III，等帶缺口的印記變綠後再進入。 綠色護盾會擋住兩個紅色印記預警後的彈幕，讓你繼續射擊。子彈會在邊緣碎裂，外圈逐漸縮短，表示保護即將結束。你也可以在圈外閃避。
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.shelterBonusHelp: 完全處於生效的綠色庇護中時，對文書官的傷害在標準為+50%/+35%、殘酷為+40%/+20%、狂亂為+25%/+5%，依序對應第一/第二階段。不提高對其他目標的傷害。
messages.boss.quarantine-heart.description: 四根軟管朝牆面噴流。站住閥門將一股水流反送核心，或從保證開放的一側攻擊。
messages.boss.quarantine-heart.name: 隔離之心
messages.boss.ragpicker-kite.brutalHelp: 殘酷形態增加斜向風道與最後的缺口環射。
messages.boss.ragpicker-kite.description: 沿風向箭頭移動，或走安靜的中央通道。擊破夾子可解除對應風道。後續增加對向風與錯時扇射。閃避時短暫無視風力。
messages.boss.ragpicker-kite.name: 拾荒者之鳶
messages.boss.ratcatcher.brutalHelp: 進階形態吹哨發出留有標記缺口的環形彈幕。後半場連吹兩次，第二次缺口會轉向。打破鼠袋只能取消放鼠，不能阻止哨聲。
messages.boss.ratcatcher.description: 三條氣味路線最多放出十二隻老鼠。半血後，捕鼠人先移動再給出完整預警。穿過路線間隙，或射擊鼠袋取消放鼠。
messages.boss.ratcatcher.name: 捕鼠人
messages.boss.ratcatcher.phaseHint.0: 從固定氣味路線之間穿過。射擊描邊鼠袋可取消一批老鼠；老鼠能繞過掩體。
messages.boss.ratcatcher.phaseHint.1: 捕鼠人每次放鼠前都會移動。認清新的地面起點，再看固定氣味路線。
messages.boss.red-abbess.description: 兩個移動聖所抵擋向內湧來的波浪。抵達任一個，並站住其淨化踏板。
messages.boss.red-abbess.name: 紅衣女院長
messages.boss.red-comet.description: 連續衝過三個固定點，軌跡按生成順序變安全。跟隨編號，穿過最早淡去的軌跡。
messages.boss.red-comet.name: 紅色彗星
messages.boss.regent.description: 亡者統治者變換位置并淹沒場地，行動前看清變形預警。
messages.boss.regent.name: 溺亡攝政王
messages.boss.salt-patriarch.description: 鹽界分三步向內收縮。穿過任一寬門，契約踏板可暫緩下一步。
messages.boss.salt-patriarch.name: 鹽之族長
messages.boss.sluice-keeper.brutalHelp: 殘暴形態在 5.1 秒後預警反向水壓，帶來新閥門與完整預警。已安排的水道保留發起時的階段。
messages.boss.sluice-keeper.crazedHelp: 瘋狂形態還會在 10.2 秒後預警第三輪水壓。每個水鋒最多命中你一次；破壞的閥門不會讓舊水鋒復活。
messages.boss.sluice-keeper.description: 藍色水流只會推動，不造成接觸傷害。水鋒移動前有獨立預警。走到乾燥岸邊，或射擊對應閥門。 兩條水道反向流動。擊碎一個閥門只會排空自己的水道並取消對應水鋒。 三條水道交替採用橫向與縱向佈局。看清箭頭與空隙；水鋒會穿過掩體。
messages.boss.sluice-keeper.lore: 議會把水位變成准許通行的街道名單之前，蕾莎·諾爾負責河閘。下城區被命令等待時，她打開了洩壓閥。那道命令把她與泵房一同封閉。她死後的雙手仍在試遍每個轉輪，尋找能讓城市喘息的那一個。
messages.boss.sluice-keeper.name: 水閘看守
messages.boss.sluice-keeper.phaseHint.0: 藍色水流只會推動，不造成接觸傷害。水鋒移動前有獨立預警。走到乾燥岸邊，或射擊對應閥門。
messages.boss.sluice-keeper.phaseHint.1: 兩條水道反向流動。擊碎一個閥門只會排空自己的水道並取消對應水鋒。
messages.boss.sluice-keeper.phaseHint.2: 三條水道交替採用橫向與縱向佈局。看清箭頭與空隙；水鋒會穿過掩體。
messages.boss.sluice-keeper.phaseHint.3: 兩條橫向水道與一條縱向水道交叉。合力上限為每秒 90 像素。在預警水鋒到來前離開路線。
messages.boss.spore-beekeeper.description: 三隻蜂巢無人機準備釋放蟲群。擊破一隻打開扇區，或使用永久保留的缺口。
messages.boss.spore-beekeeper.name: 孢子養蜂人
messages.boss.stationmaster.brutalHelp: 殘暴形態在7秒後安排反向發車，帶來新號誌與完整預警。待發列車保留發起時的階段。
messages.boss.stationmaster.crazedHelp: 瘋狂形態在12秒後再加第三輪發車。整輪發車連同後續交叉線最多命中你一次。後續列車使用新號誌。
messages.boss.stationmaster.description: 兩條軌道中始終有一條開放。箭頭表示暢通，叉號表示來車。每列車有2秒預警。離開軌道，或射擊關閉的號誌。 三條軌道輪流留出一條通路。打壞號誌只會開放對應軌道，其他列車仍會行駛。 三條橫向軌道之後，4秒後出現一對獨立預警的縱向軌道。列車會穿過掩體；只有移動的車身造成傷害。
messages.boss.stationmaster.lore: 議會下令封鎖下層月台時，奈里斯·維爾扣住了末班車。她清點上車的傷員，沒有檢查他們的通行證。大門關閉後發車鈴響了，卻從未留下到站紀錄。她的號誌仍向願意穿過月台的人許諾一條暢通的軌道。
messages.boss.stationmaster.name: 末代站長
messages.boss.stationmaster.phaseHint.0: 兩條軌道中始終有一條開放。箭頭表示暢通，叉號表示來車。每列車有2秒預警。離開軌道，或射擊關閉的號誌。
messages.boss.stationmaster.phaseHint.1: 三條軌道輪流留出一條通路。打壞號誌只會開放對應軌道，其他列車仍會行駛。
messages.boss.stationmaster.phaseHint.2: 三條橫向軌道之後，4秒後出現一對獨立預警的縱向軌道。列車會穿過掩體；只有移動的車身造成傷害。
messages.boss.stationmaster.phaseHint.3: 兩條縱向軌道之後，3.6秒後出現一對獨立預警的橫向軌道。每一波始終留有一條開放軌道。
messages.boss.stitchwright.brutalHelp: 殘暴形態從第一階段就會回針縫，並保留存活的縫針。每次攻擊都有完整預警，且只能命中一次。
messages.boss.stitchwright.crazedHelp: 瘋狂形態增加獨立預警的交叉縫線，盡可能瞄準另一名可見倖存者。裙邊期間，它會等到開口逃生結束後再發動。
messages.boss.stitchwright.description: 縫針標出固定的線。虛線變為實線前離開，或射擊任一縫針剪斷線。 新的預警後，縫線會再次攻擊。毀壞的針不會復原。射擊束縛物，或在其旁按住互動一秒，解救倖存者。 三面的裙邊向內收攏。沿空心箭頭穿過開口，或擊毀縫針打開另一邊。接近路線沒有傷害。
messages.boss.stitchwright.name: 縫合匠
messages.boss.stitchwright.phaseHint.0: 縫針標出固定的線。虛線變為實線前離開，或射擊任一縫針剪斷線。
messages.boss.stitchwright.phaseHint.1: 新的預警後，縫線會再次攻擊。毀壞的針不會復原。射擊束縛物，或在其旁按住互動一秒，解救倖存者。
messages.boss.stitchwright.phaseHint.2: 三面的裙邊向內收攏。沿空心箭頭穿過開口，或擊毀縫針打開另一邊。接近路線沒有傷害。
messages.boss.stitchwright.phaseHint.3: 兩個裙邊依次收攏，開口方向不同。第一個結束後，查看下一個箭頭。
messages.boss.tollkeeper.brutalHelp: 進階輪子會在牆邊停下，預警側向硬幣彈幕。後半場增加第三段路程。輪子仍佔據自己的標記路線；硬幣間的缺口不能擋住輪子。
messages.boss.tollkeeper.description: 硬幣輪滾向牆壁後返回。標準形態的分文不差會在發射前鎖定完整反彈路線。收攤關卡先移動，輪子停在牆邊後才鎖定回程。每個新方向都會先預警。
messages.boss.tollkeeper.name: 收稅人
messages.boss.tollkeeper.phaseHint.0: 看清輪子的箭頭，離開路線，再從輪後穿過。趁恢復空檔攻擊。
messages.boss.tollkeeper.phaseHint.1: 收費亭先移動再投輪。輪子在牆邊停下，再預警重新瞄準的回程。看清每個新箭頭。
messages.boss.uncounted.description: 鐘聲銘記被抹去的名字。在秘密試煉中迎接螺旋、光束、召喚與瞬移。
messages.boss.uncounted.name: 無名眾
messages.boss.unlit-astronomer.description: 兩個繞行危險圍繞無害安全標記運轉。沿空心標記軌道移動，避開實心危險。
messages.boss.unlit-astronomer.name: 無光天文學家
messages.boss.vesper-judge.description: 判決標記半邊場地，隨後重擊。預警時跨過中央線，另一半始終開放。
messages.boss.vesper-judge.name: 晚禱法官
messages.boss.walking-district.description: 兩塊建築沿標記路線移動並露出核心。走外圍繞道，或等落定後穿過中央。
messages.boss.walking-district.name: 行走城區
messages.boss.wire-harpist.description: 三根弦按低、中、高編號順序攻擊。依據下一弦虛線和可視倒數切換通道。
messages.boss.wire-harpist.name: 鐵絲豎琴師
messages.boss.wire-seamstress.description: 三個錨點形成折線圍欄，留有固定門口。穿門，或摧毀錨點移除相連鐵絲。
messages.boss.wire-seamstress.name: 鐵絲裁縫
messages.boss.zero-hour-conductor.description: 四個可見節拍依次釋放交替通道攻擊。跟隨節拍圓點與安全通道標記，無須聽音辨拍。
messages.boss.zero-hour-conductor.name: 零時指揮家
messages.class.assassin.lore: Vale 曾在守衛遺棄的街區送信，至今仍記得回家的小巷。
messages.class.assassin.name: 刺客
messages.class.engineer.lore: Tamsin 用不相配的零件修理工具，相信城市也能如此修復。
messages.class.engineer.name: 工程師
messages.class.heavy.lore: Hux 帶著鑄造廠最后一臺供彈電機走上街頭。
messages.class.heavy.name: 重裝射手
messages.class.mage.lore: Sable 研究過禁忌鐘音；解藥與詛咒寫在同一本筆記中。
messages.class.mage.name: 法師
messages.class.mage.role: 區域控制與爆發魔法傷害。
messages.class.medic.lore: 紙用盡后，Iona 將名字寫在繃帶上。鐘聲休想抹去它們。
messages.class.medic.name: 醫護
messages.class.soldier.lore: Mara 拒絕封死醫務室的大門，每次行動前都清點所有人。
messages.class.soldier.name: 士兵
messages.class.soldier.role: 穩定的遠程傷害與小隊指揮。
messages.class.tank.lore: Bram 背著比房屋更長壽的門。盾牌身后總要有人。
messages.class.tank.name: 坦克
messages.journal.classHelp: 以{name}完成遭遇戰。即使本輪戰敗，已完成的戰鬥仍會計入。
messages.journal.collectionHelp: 發現這條路線的不同普通首領。每個身分在所有模式中僅計一次。
messages.journal.endlessHelp: 突破你親自完成的無盡守夜紀錄。中途加入只計算自己的通關數。
messages.journal.ensembleHelp: 用不同職業從頭完成戰役或突襲。
messages.journal.letterLocked: 獲得該職業的首枚印章即可尋回信件。
messages.journal.notice: 進度保存在本裝置。目標獎勵故事與印章，不提供戰鬥能力或線上排名。
messages.journal.prepared: 這是建議的配置。開始前請檢查職業、路線與難度。
messages.journal.preparedTeam: 此目標需要隊友。已準備私人房間，請在建立前檢查設定。
messages.journal.rescuesHelp: 復活隊友。自我復甦不計入。
messages.journal.routeHelp: 由開局就加入的同一名倖存者完成整場戰役或突襲。
messages.journal.storyActsHelp: 從城門開始，在同一局劇情戰役中完成5、10和15場戰鬥。中途加入不會繼承先前章節。
messages.journal.storyEndingsHelp: 找回庇護、見證和拒絕三個結局。選擇最多的立場決定結局；次數相同則以最近的選擇為準。每局記錄一個結局。
messages.journal.title: 戰地手記
messages.mode.endless.description: 連續迎戰首領，沒有最終回合。在戰鬥間投票、購物和補員，危險不斷升級。支持單人及最多五十人同游。
messages.mode.endless.name: 無盡守夜
messages.mode.long.description: 十六場戰鬥遍歷全部城區，包含精英挑戰與更多幸存者見證。
messages.mode.long.name: 黑鐘朝圣
messages.mode.raid.description: 最多十六人挑戰三場延長的首領戰，采用加速構筑和大型協作目標。
messages.mode.raid.name: 大型突襲
messages.mode.short.description: 從破損城門到水淹議事廳的五項契約，組成一場緊湊而完整的戰役。
messages.mode.short.name: 隔離突圍
messages.mode.standard.description: 橫跨隔離城區的十項契約，完成構筑并迎戰最終首領。
messages.mode.standard.name: 午夜巡回
messages.mode.story.description: 三幕共15場戰鬥。隊伍投票選擇地點與契約，決定三個可收集結局。使用現有的實得技能點預算。
messages.mode.story.name: 劇情戰役

messages.ui.storyReadyHelp: 依自己的步調閱讀。所有在線倖存者點選準備後才進入戰備。
messages.ui.supplyHelp: 可攜帶三種物品，每種兩個。按{bindings}或點按物品欄使用。
messages.ui.tagline: 守住陣線，銘記他們的名字。
messages.ui.teamRecordIneligible: 本局不符合隊伍記錄的條件。
messages.ui.teamRecordSaveFailed: 隊伍成績尚未儲存。留在房間內時會繼續重試。
messages.ui.teamRecordScope: 此遊戲伺服器上的隊伍成績。單人練習和測試對局不計入榜單。
messages.ui.teamRecordUnavailable: 無法載入隊伍記錄。請檢查網路後重試。
messages.ui.testingApplied: 測試數值已套用。本次挑戰不儲存、不計記錄。
messages.ui.testingBuild: 測試版本·可選首領，各難度皆有指南
messages.ui.testingNoRecords: 套用變更將停用本次挑戰的儲存與記錄。開始新挑戰可恢復普通遊玩。
messages.ui.testingSoloOnly: 金幣和技能點工具僅限單人。
messages.ui.testingUnlocked: 本分頁的新挑戰已解鎖測試難度。
messages.ui.translationNotice: 譯文由人工智能編寫，尚待母語使用者審校。
messages.ui.tutorialCombat: 避開珊瑚色子彈和標記區域。在倒下的隊友附近持續救援兩秒即可救起。每場戰鬥之間會恢復生命並補滿彈匣。
messages.ui.tutorialDodge: 使用 {binding} 閃避，在短時間內穿過危險。
messages.ui.tutorialMove: 使用 {binding} 移動；用指針或瞄準搖桿瞄準。
messages.ui.tutorialShop: 選擇武器或技能圖示以查看效果。在大廳和戰鬥間隙花費金幣與技能點。一條完整專精需21點，且只能啟用一個終極天賦。
messages.ui.tutorialTeam: 保持救援距離；隱身期間仍會受到已有危險的傷害。
messages.ui.tutorialUltimate: 使用 {binding} 釋放終極技能。冷卻和升級內容見技能樹。
messages.ui.variantPressureHelp: 圓圈填滿前離開鎖定位置。趁預警穿過標記通道；狂亂形態會延遲追加垂直切割。
messages.ui.victoryBanked: 戰役勝利與獎勵已儲存。
messages.ui.voteTie: 平票按本局固定候選順序決定。
messages.ui.waitingCapacity: 等待伺服器空位 · 佇列 {position}
messages.ui.wardApproachHelp: 在分診院清除三群死者。每次出現前都有預警。此獨立練習不授予首領擊敗紀錄或成長獎勵。
messages.ui.welcomeLanguageHelp: 你之後可以在選單中變更語言。

messages.class.bard.role: 節奏音符射擊、近距離支援與定向彈幕控制。
messages.class.bard.lore: 伊文曾在舞臺後臺工作，最近才開始吟遊詩人的修習。他正在學習給別人的回答留出時間。
messages.ability.bard-q.name: 終止樂句
messages.ability.bard-e.name: 切入
messages.ability.bard-ultimate.name: 返場
messages.ability.bard-q.description: 消耗節奏，每隔0.75秒釋放一次脈衝，共3次。每次造成20＋每點節奏5傷害，使普通敵人減速25%、持續1.25秒，並賦予6＋每點節奏3護盾、持續2秒。Q跟隨自身；護盾取較強值並遵守難度上限。
messages.ability.bard-e.description: 沿210單位的細直線造成65傷害，最多消除8枚敵方彈體，遇掩體停止。光束、領域和已有預警保持不變。
messages.ability.bard-ultimate.description: 消耗節奏，在原地放置每秒一次、共6次的演奏。205範圍內造成36＋每點節奏4傷害，賦予18＋每點節奏2護盾、持續2秒。返場停留在施放點，不治療或復活。
messages.ui.bardCadence: 節奏 {count}/3 · 音符命中累積；Q或終極技能消耗。
messages.talent.held-note.name: 延長音
messages.talent.held-note.description: Q的最後一次脈衝範圍擴大40%，護盾加倍，並使普通敵人減速2.5秒。
messages.talent.travelling-chorus.name: 行進合唱
messages.talent.travelling-chorus.description: 返場跟隨演奏者移動，不再固定在施放位置。
messages.talent.borrowed-cue.name: 借來的信號
messages.talent.borrowed-cue.description: 切入留下一個持續4秒、生命30的聲音誘餌。新的瞄準攻擊可選擇它；已有預警的位置不變。

messages.class.swordsman.name: 劍士
messages.class.swordsman.role: 需要承擔出手風險的斬擊、精確進步與正面反擊。
messages.class.swordsman.lore: 達拉曾在磨刀臺工作，最近才開始練劍。比起距離，她更會判斷刀刃。
messages.ability.swordsman-q.name: 量距斬
messages.ability.swordsman-e.name: 正面架擋
messages.ability.swordsman-ultimate.name: 長間距
messages.ability.swordsman-q.description: 向選定方向蓄勢0.2秒，前進最多90單位，對130單位內造成75傷害。掩體阻擋移動和刀刃；閃避取消斬擊。不獲得無敵。
messages.ability.swordsman-e.description: 在固定正面位置架擋11幀，最多攔住3枚飛來的敵彈。成功架擋開啟3秒反擊機會：下次開始的普通斬擊傷害增加60%。背後彈體、光束、領域、近戰和已有預警仍危險；閃避取消架擋。
messages.ability.swordsman-ultimate.description: 7秒內，接下來開始的3次普通斬擊範圍增加40、傷害增加35%。空揮或取消仍消耗次數。不自動攻擊、不反彈、不提供無敵。
messages.supply.swordsman-canteen.name: 水壺
messages.supply.swordsman-canteen.description: 立即恢復氣息。不治療，也不提供無敵。
messages.talent.return-step.name: 回步
messages.talent.return-step.description: Q斬擊8幀後後退60單位。掩體阻擋後退，不獲得無敵。
messages.talent.open-circle.name: 開圓
messages.talent.open-circle.description: 強化普通斬擊覆蓋整圈，基礎傷害加成從35%降為15%。
messages.talent.second-watch.name: 二次守望
messages.talent.second-watch.description: E提供兩段各5幀的架擋，中間有5幀空檔。總共仍只擋3枚彈體。

messages.class.summoner.name: 召喚師
messages.class.summoner.role: 召集數量有限的隨從，標記目標，透過命令和實際歸隊保護它們。
messages.class.summoner.lore: 喬斯·梅羅曾安排市場送貨，後來才開始召喚師訓練。他舊送貨單上仍有未勾選的方格。
messages.ui.retinue.escortHint: 跟隨召喚師，攻擊附近的敵人。
messages.ui.retinue.holdHint: 駐守瞄準方向最多140單位內可到達的地點。掩體限制落點。
messages.ui.retinue.focusHint: 只攻擊被你普通攻擊實際命中並標記的敵人。標記持續8秒。
messages.supply.summoner-thread-spool.name: 縛繩線軸
messages.supply.summoner-thread-spool.description: 立即補滿普通攻擊的專注。不會治療或召集隨從。攜帶上限：{maximum}。
messages.talent.running-pack.name: 疾行犬群
messages.talent.running-pack.description: 改為召來2隻獵犬，取代均衡組合。牠們生命降低20%，移動速度提高12%。常駐和總容量上限不變。
messages.talent.closed-ranks.name: 緊密隊列
messages.talent.closed-ranks.description: 歸隊到達改為獲得4秒45%傷害減免，不再恢復生命。施放時已有的每個隨從只獲得一次到達收益。
messages.talent.patient-company.name: 耐心同伴
messages.talent.patient-company.description: 臨時守衛多持續8秒，失去隨從全體25%的傷害加成；終極技能強度仍強化守衛本身。
messages.ability.summoner-q.name: 召集隨從
messages.ability.summoner-q.description: 在附近可用空間召來1隻拼布獵犬和1隻燈籠翼，初始最多4個常駐隨從。存活者保留目前生命；容量已滿或落點受阻時不消耗冷卻。隨從擁有真實移動、攻擊和生命，並受掩體阻擋。
messages.ability.summoner-e.name: 歸隊
messages.ability.summoner-e.description: 4秒內，存活隨從以提高40%的速度實際返回。施放時已存在的每個隨從到達後可恢復一次12點基礎生命。不會傳送、復活、反覆到達刷治療或獲得無敵。
messages.ability.summoner-ultimate.name: 開放徵召
messages.ability.summoner-ultimate.description: 召來最多2個臨時藤編守衛，持續16秒，其間隨從傷害提高25%。所有形態合計每位主人最多8個。臨時形態到期退場，不爆炸也不返還資源。

messages.class.ranger.name: 遊俠
messages.class.ranger.role: 鎖定弓箭瞄準，控制通路，利用預先佈置的射位。
messages.class.ranger.lore: 內拉·文曾抄錄水務勘測路線，最近才開始遊俠訓練。她圖上的一條線仍可能讓真正走那條路的人陷入困境。
messages.supply.ranger-arrow-bundle.name: 備用箭束
messages.supply.ranger-arrow-bundle.description: 立即補滿普通箭袋。不重置能力、絆索或射位次數。攜帶上限：{maximum}。
messages.talent.crosswind.name: 側風
messages.talent.crosswind.description: 引弦一線消耗3支備好的箭，射出3支窄扇形實體箭，每支傷害為50%。完整拉弓時間不變；閃避取消不會退還箭。
messages.talent.linked-stakes.name: 連樁
messages.talent.linked-stakes.description: 每條絆索在共同次數限制內命中3個不同敵人。不重複傷害同一目標，也不定身首領。
messages.talent.long-survey.name: 長時勘測
messages.talent.long-survey.description: 將2個射位換為前方1個，持續14秒，額外傷害90%。次數、半徑和開始拉弓時消耗的規則仍然有限。
messages.ability.ranger-q.name: 引弦一線
messages.ability.ranger-q.description: 消耗1支備好的箭。鎖定瞄準0.4秒，其間移速為55%，隨後射出傷害95、穿透2、射程980的實體箭。掩體會阻擋。閃避會取消發射，但不退還箭或冷卻。
messages.ability.ranger-e.name: 絆索
messages.ability.ranger-e.description: 在合法地面設置有限絆索：0.8秒布防，生效後持續20秒，初始最多2條。敵人實際穿越時受到45傷害，普通敵人減速40%，持續3秒。首領只受傷害，不被定身或中斷攻擊。容量已滿或位置受阻不消耗冷卻。
messages.ability.ranger-ultimate.name: 測繪迴路

messages.class.alchemist.name: 鍊金術師
messages.class.alchemist.role: 用有限材料配製藥劑，佈置延遲落地的藥瓶，並組合自己的調配效果。
messages.class.alchemist.lore: 佩林進入鍊金術師訓練前曾在染坊工作。比起自信滿滿的解釋，他們更相信能夠重複得到的結果，至今仍保留著失敗批次的筆記。

messages.supply.alchemist-sample-case.name: 樣品
messages.supply.alchemist-sample-case.description: 立即補滿主武器風箱的樣品。不會恢復材料、備好藥瓶、技能冷卻或批次強化次數。攜帶上限：{maximum}。
messages.talent.split-pour.name: 分裝傾注
messages.talent.split-pour.description: 每次投擲在左右各偏移24單位的位置產生兩次實際落地，每處效力為55%、半徑為72%。兩處合計只消耗一瓶備好藥劑，至多消耗一次終極技能次數。掩體可能擋住其中一處。
messages.talent.settled-batch.name: 靜置批次
messages.talent.settled-batch.description: 調配時間由0.4秒延長至0.8秒。每瓶藥劑效力增加25%，保存上限由兩瓶提高至三瓶。閃避取消仍不退材料。
messages.talent.second-extraction.name: 二次萃取
messages.talent.second-extraction.description: 投擲藥瓶的基礎冷卻增加2秒。有效的初始濺射返還該配方最先消耗的材料1份，每組投擲最多一次。投空和後續區域脈衝均不返還。
messages.ability.alchemist-q.name: 小批調配
messages.ability.alchemist-q.description: 先消耗所選配方的材料，以80%移動速度調配0.4秒。最多保存兩瓶配方已固定的藥劑。閃避會取消調配，材料不退還。焰劑消耗餘燼、白堊各1；縛劑消耗白堊、樹液各1；癒劑消耗餘燼、樹液各1。
messages.ability.alchemist-e.name: 投擲藥瓶
messages.ability.alchemist-e.description: 把最早備好的藥瓶投向300單位內的指定位置，也可投在近處或自己腳下，0.5秒後落地。焰劑造成55傷害並留下持續8秒的區域，每隔1.5秒造成4傷害，共五次。縛劑造成25傷害，使普通敵人減速40%、持續3秒；其8秒區域會短暫刷新減速五次。癒劑恢復18點已損失生命。掩體阻擋落點與濺射。你的焰劑可消耗自己的縛劑區域，使初始傷害增加30。癒劑可熄滅自己的火區，但不增加治療，剩餘脈衝隨之消失。
messages.ability.alchemist-ultimate.name: 標準批次
messages.ability.alchemist-ultimate.description: 每種戰鬥材料恢復1，各自最多6。14秒內，接下來三次實際投擲的效力增加50%、半徑增加25%。要在基礎冷卻下用完三次，需預先備好藥瓶並在投擲可用時啟動。投空也會消耗次數。僅啟動不會造成傷害，也不會提供無敵。
messages.weapon.alchemist-0.name: 手持風箱
messages.weapon.alchemist-0.description: 具有有限射程的實際投藥彈每發消耗一份主武器樣品。主攻擊實際產生正向效果時，可恢復庫存最少的戰鬥材料1份，每秒最多一次。空射不會恢復。另有獨立戰鬥計時，每5秒恢復一份材料。每種材料初始3份，上限各6份。重裝風箱使用無限儲備的主武器樣品，不會補充配方材料。

messages.skill.engineer-traps-1.name: Pressure Charges
messages.pathway.engineer-machinery-1.summary: Move your machine, then hold position to let it brace and fire. Q keeps its 18-second base cooldown.
messages.pathway.engineer-traps-1.summary: Prepare an approach and lure enemies into armed ground. Q keeps its 18-second base cooldown.
messages.skill.engineer-machinery-1.description: Q deploys an 80-health carriage for 12 seconds. It follows your movement at 150 pixels/second while holding its deployment offset, then braces for 0.5 seconds before firing at visible enemies within 420 pixels. Base output is 30 damage/second while braced; moving stops fire and banks no shots. Siege overclock, Crossfire Pair and extra-turret capacity still apply. Replaces Rivet Turret; excludes Pressure Charges.
messages.skill.engineer-traps-1.description: Q places one charge 120 pixels ahead: 1 second to arm, then a 44-pixel trigger and a visible 0.5-second fuse. Its 100-pixel blast deals 150 base damage, with turret-damage bonuses; ordinary enemies slow by 50% for 2 seconds, bosses are never slowed. Cover blocks triggering and blasts. Maximum two owned charges, each expiring after 36 seconds. Invalid ground or full capacity spends no cooldown. Replaces Q turrets; excludes Carriage Sentry, Crossfire Pair and extra-turret capstones. Barricade and Impossible Machine remain available.

messages.skill.engineer-machinery-anchor-1.name: Anchor Circuit
messages.skill.engineer-machinery-anchor-1.descri: Q during deployment cooldown anchors all owned carriages; press again to resume following. Orders recover in 0.8 seconds and require 0.5 seconds of fresh bracing. Invalid recall paths spend nothing. Excludes Survey Drive. When Q deployment is ready, Q deploys normally.
messages.pathway.engineer-machinery-anchor-1.summ: Q during deployment cooldown anchors all owned carriages; press again to resume following. messages.skill.engineer-machinery-survey-1.name: Survey Drive
messages.skill.engineer-machinery-survey-1.descri: Q during deployment cooldown orders all owned carriages to a fixed point 220 pixels ahead of your aim, keeping their lateral formation. They travel at 150 pixels/second, then brace for 0.5 seconds. Aim changes do not move the destination. Blocked cover, lava or map edges reject the whole order without spending recovery. Excludes Anchor Circuit. Ready Q deploys normally.

messages.skill.engineer-machinery-coil-1.name: Coil Lance
messages.skill.engineer-machinery-coil-1.descript: Adds a fourth active action (default C; remappable). A live owned carriage locks its aim and charges for 0.75 seconds, then fires a 480-pixel piercing beam for 240 base damage. Cover clips the beam. It cannot move or fire normal shots while charging. Base cooldown 12 seconds; requires enough remaining carriage lifetime. Destruction or owner loss cancels the shot.

messages.skill.engineer-machinery-prism-1.name: Prism Coils
messages.skill.engineer-machinery-prism-1.descrip: Evolves Coil Lance into three separately timed rays, angled left, centre and right. Each deals 110 base damage, 0.18 seconds apart after the charge. A wider clearing pattern and 330 total base damage if all three strike; targets can move between rays. Uses the same fourth action and cooldown.

messages.skill.engineer-machinery-salvage-1.name: Salvage Pulse
messages.skill.engineer-machinery-salvage-1.descr: Adds a fifth active action (default B; remappable). Dismantles your idle carriages within 125 pixels and recovers up to 6 seconds of the remaining Q deployment cooldown, once per cast. It consumes the machines and their remaining uptime. Base cooldown 24 seconds. Channeling machines, siege engines, other players’ machines and companions cannot be salvaged. Grants no health, SP, money or kill credit.

messages.skill.general-brake-step.name: Brake Step
messages.skill.general-brake-step.description: Release and press Dodge again during your dodge to stop its movement at your current position. The brake spends no extra charge and grants no refund; the original protection deadline and sequential recharge remain. Hold does not repeatedly dodge with Brake Step equipped. This controls an ordinary dodge, not a class rush or rescue charge.
messages.skill.general-course-correction.name: Course Correction
messages.skill.general-course-correction.descript: Requires Sprint. During an ordinary dodge, hold Sprint and change movement direction by at least 30 degrees. Spend 20 stamina to turn up to 90 degrees once during that dodge. Its speed, duration, original protection deadline and charge recovery remain. No turn while exhausted or with insufficient stamina. This does not steer class rushes or rescue charges.
messages.skill.engineer-traps-wire-1.name: Tripwire Couplers
messages.skill.engineer-traps-wire-1.description: Two ready owned plates within 360 pixels share a visible wire when the whole connection clears cover and lava. A living hostile body crossing its swept line commits both 0.5-second fuses. The plates keep their original 36-second lifetimes and proximity triggers. Excludes Safety Switch.

Plates with insufficient lifetime cannot fire. Base cooldown 12 seconds. Arming, hauling and spent plates are excluded; this grants no new charges or explosions.
messages.skill.engineer-traps-casings-1.name: Breach Casings
messages.skill.engineer-traps-casings-1.descripti: Evolves committed explosions with a 320-pixel piercing shaped jet along each plate’s placed direction, for 120 base damage with ability and turret-damage bonuses. Its full lane is shown during the fuse. Cover can shorten the warned lane; removing cover cannot extend the committed warning. The ordinary blast and boss slow immunity remain.
messages.pathway.engineer-traps-casings-1.summary: Evolves committed explosions with a 320-pixel piercing shaped jet along each plate’s placed direction, for 120 base damage with ability and turret-damage bonuses. Its full lane is shown during the fuse. Cover can shorten the warned lane; removing cover cannot extend the committed warning. The ordinary blast and boss slow immunity remain.
messages.skill.engineer-traps-haul-1.name: Haul Line
messages.skill.engineer-traps-haul-1.description: Adds a fifth active action (default B; remappable). Winch the nearest ready owned plate within 320 pixels to a legal point 120 pixels ahead of your aim over 0.6 seconds. It then needs a full 1-second rearm. Blocked paths, overlapping destinations and insufficient lifetime reject without spending recovery. Interruption stops the haul and rearms a legally placed plate; obstructed equipment is removed. The original lifetime remains. Base cooldown 18 seconds.

messages.skill.engineer-traps-corridor-1.name: Demolition Corridor
messages.skill.engineer-traps-corridor-1.descript: SS+ capstone: remote-fire two ready owned plates within 360 pixels on a clear 26-pixel-radius strip. Both actual explosions must deliver, then a further visible 0.4-second commitment releases 300 base damage along their fixed connection. Ground obstruction, expiry or owner loss cancels the strip. Clear paired commitment uses a 16-second cooldown; ordinary remote firing remains 12 seconds. Uses the run’s single capstone choice.
messages.pathway.engineer-traps-corridor-1.summar: SS+ capstone: remote-fire two ready owned plates within 360 pixels on a clear 26-pixel-radius strip. messages.pathway.engineer-builder-1.name: Builder
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-1.summary: Q assembles a 100-base-health screen 120 pixels ahead instead of Rivet Turret. Its 220-pixel frontage takes 0.5 seconds to brace before it blocks hostile shots. It lasts 30 seconds; friendly movement stays clear. One owned Q group at a time. Blocked ground, lava, map edges or full capacity spend no cooldown. Q keeps its 18-second base recovery. Barricade and Impossible Machine retain their roles.
messages.ui.pathwayRouteHelp: Compare all three Q identities, or open one route for a closer view. Inspection spends nothing; choosing an entry commits this run.
messages.skill.engineer-builder-1.name: Field Screen
messages.skill.engineer-builder-1.description: Q assembles a 100-base-health screen 120 pixels ahead instead of Rivet Turret. Its 220-pixel frontage takes 0.5 seconds to brace before it blocks hostile shots. It lasts 30 seconds; friendly movement stays clear. One owned Q group at a time. Blocked ground, lava, map edges or full capacity spend no cooldown. Q keeps its 18-second base recovery. Barricade and Impossible Machine retain their roles.
messages.skill.engineer-builder-longspan-1.name: Longspan Panels
messages.skill.engineer-builder-longspan-1.descri: The Q screen spans 380 pixels instead of 220, with the same total health. More frontage means more incoming fire can wear it down. Excludes Return Wings.
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-longspan-1.summ: The Q screen spans 380 pixels instead of 220, with the same total health. More frontage means more incoming fire can wear it down. Excludes Return Wings.
messages.skill.engineer-builder-wings-1.name: Return Wings
messages.skill.engineer-builder-wings-1.descripti: Replace the front screen with two angled 150-pixel side panels, sharing the original 100-base-health budget. They protect the flanks and leave the central approach exposed. The pair counts as one Q group. Excludes Longspan Panels.
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-wings-1.summary: Replace the front screen with two angled 150-pixel side panels, sharing the original 100-base-health budget. They protect the flanks and leave the central approach exposed. The pair counts as one Q group. Excludes Longspan Panels.
messages.skill.engineer-builder-hinge-1.name: Hinged Assembly
messages.skill.engineer-builder-hinge-1.descripti: Adds action 1 (default C; remappable). Fold a nearby Q group and pivot it to your fixed aimed heading over 0.5 seconds. Folded panels do not stop bullets. Reach 320 pixels; base cooldown 6 seconds. The whole rotation must clear cover, lava and map edges. Health and original expiry stay unchanged.
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-hinge-1.summary: Adds action 1 (default C; remappable). Fold a nearby Q group and pivot it to your fixed aimed heading over 0.5 seconds. Folded panels do not stop bullets. Reach 320 pixels; base cooldown 6 seconds. The whole rotation must clear cover, lava and map edges. Health and original expiry stay unchanged.
messages.skill.engineer-builder-repair-1.name: Field Maintenance
messages.skill.engineer-builder-repair-1.descript: Adds action 2 (default B; remappable). Remain within 8 pixels of your starting point for 0.8 seconds to restore up to 45 base health to the nearest damaged owned wall within 180 pixels. Movement, folding, cover, owner loss or destruction interrupts the work. Base cooldown 16 seconds. No resurrection, lifetime extension, player healing or shield gain.

messages.skill.engineer-builder-linked-1.name: Linked Foundations
messages.skill.engineer-builder-linked-1.descript: Maintain two separate Q screen groups. Each keeps its own construction delay, health and original 30-second lifetime. Existing Barricade and redoubt panels use their own limits. No extra turret purchase is needed.
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-linked-1.summar: Maintain two separate Q screen groups. Each keeps its own construction delay, health and original 30-second lifetime. Existing Barricade and redoubt panels use their own limits. No extra turret purchase is needed.
messages.skill.engineer-builder-survey-1.name: Survey Frame
messages.skill.engineer-builder-survey-1.descript: Evolve action 1: fold, pivot and shift a nearby Q group up to 120 pixels toward a fixed point 120 pixels ahead of your aim, then rebrace. The whole path must be clear. Construction takes 0.8 seconds; base cooldown 8 seconds. No protection while folded, no health reset and no lifetime extension.
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-survey-1.summar: Evolve action 1: fold, pivot and shift a nearby Q group up to 120 pixels toward a fixed point 120 pixels ahead of your aim, then rebrace. The whole path must be clear. Construction takes 0.8 seconds; base cooldown 8 seconds. No protection while folded, no health reset and no lifetime extension.
messages.skill.engineer-builder-redoubt-1.name: Keystone Redoubt
messages.skill.engineer-builder-redoubt-1.descrip: SS+ capstone: your ultimate still deploys Impossible Machine with its issued health, fire, duration and optional mobility. On clear ground it also assembles three 90-base-health panels around that initial position over 0.8 seconds. They last at most 12 seconds and disappear if the linked machine or owner is lost. The opening stays accessible and teammates can pass through. A moving machine leaves its fortification behind. Blocked fortification ground preserves the machine without adding panels. Uses the run’s single capstone.
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-redoubt-1.summa: SS+ capstone: your ultimate still deploys Impossible Machine with its issued health, fire, duration and optional mobility. messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-1.name: Skirmisher
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-1.name: Passing Shot
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-advance-1.name: Crossing Advance
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-rear-1.name: Rear Guard
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-1.description: After Precision Burst, use action 1 within 1.2 seconds while holding movement. Commit a legal 90-pixel step over 0.3 seconds, then fire one 15-base-damage piercing round along the aim you committed. The original burst, rally and ultimate remain. One follow-up per burst; 6-second base recovery. No dodge immunity or free ammunition. Obstruction, hostile slow/displacement, dodge or owner loss cancels unfinished work without a refund.
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-advance-1.descr: Passing Shot becomes a committed forward crossing along your starting aim. Its same follow-up damage is split equally between a departure round and an arrival round. Aim again for the arrival shot while your route stays fixed. No extra total follow-up damage, terrain bypass or immunity. Excludes Rear Guard.
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-rear-1.descript: Passing Shot becomes a committed backward step from your starting aim. Fire the same follow-up damage halfway through and intercept at most one visible hostile projectile in a 96-pixel forward lane with 12-pixel clearance. Other projectiles, contact, fixed warnings and hazards remain dangerous. Cover blocks interception. Excludes Crossing Advance.
messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-1.summary: Burst, choose a legal step, then fire on arrival. Keep the ordinary burst and rally.
messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-advance-1.sum: Commit forward; fire on departure, then aim the arrival round again.
messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-rear-1.summar: Commit backward; a timed guard shot can intercept one visible projectile.
messages.ui.soldier.manualHelp: Choose a firing discipline and inspect its controls, costs and commitments. Your rally, Precision Burst and Last Roll Call remain part of every build.
messages.ui.soldier.kitHelp: Your issued rally, Precision Burst and Last Roll Call remain. A firing discipline adds its own action. Inspect its General foundation and exclusions before buying.
messages.ui.soldier.passingHelp: After Precision Burst, hold a movement direction and use action 1 within 1.2 seconds. The committed step fires on arrival. It grants no dodge immunity.
messages.ui.soldier.advanceHelp: After Precision Burst, use action 1 within 1.2 seconds to commit forward along your aim. Fire on departure, then aim the arrival round again. The route stays fixed.
messages.ui.soldier.rearHelp: After Precision Burst, use action 1 within 1.2 seconds to commit backward from your aim. The halfway guard shot can intercept one visible projectile; it does not make you invulnerable.
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-drill-1.name: Cartridge Drill
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-roving-1.name: Roving Chamber
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-drill-1.descrip: Earn action 2: load up to four missing rounds, one at a time, while walking. The first takes 35% of your weapon's current full-reload time; later rounds take 20% each. Primary fire waits. Use action 2 again to stop and keep completed rounds. Fresh Precision Burst, a committed Passing Shot, dodge, ordinary Reload or health damage interrupts. Replacing an ordinary reload forfeits its unfinished work. 12-second base recovery. Ordinary Reload still fills the whole magazine.
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-roving-1.descri: Cartridge Drill can continue through fresh Precision Burst and Passing Shot, including either early fork. Coordinate loading, burst and a committed step without waiting for all four rounds. The same finite round count, timing and recovery remain. Dodge, ordinary Reload and health damage still interrupt. No extra ammunition beyond magazine capacity, immunity or cooldown refund.
messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-drill-1.summa: Take a few rounds early; stop loading when you have enough to fire.
messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-roving-1.summ: Keep hand-loading while you burst and commit a step.
messages.ui.soldier.drillHelp: Action 2 loads at most four missing rounds. Use it again to stop and keep completed rounds; held primary fire then resumes. Ordinary Reload fills the whole magazine. Fresh burst/committed step, dodge, ordinary Reload and health damage stop this drill.
messages.ui.soldier.rovingHelp: Your finite drill can continue through burst and a committed step. Use action 2 again to stop and keep completed rounds. Dodge, ordinary Reload and health damage still stop it. Ordinary Reload keeps its full-magazine role.
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-ready-1.name: Ready Round
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-volley-1.name: Running Volley
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-ready-1.descrip: The first actual Cartridge Drill insertion opens 1.2 seconds for a paid Passing Shot. Spend one magazine round to use your owned step variant without a burst opening. Its normal recovery still applies. A ready Precision Burst follow-up takes priority and stays free. Invalid ground spends nothing. Dodge, ordinary Reload, health damage and owner or weapon loss clear the loaded opening. Starting a reload or receiving a refill does not create one.
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-volley-1.descri: A loaded step opening can be spent during Passing Shot recovery. Once per drill, finish the first paid step and actually insert at least three rounds to earn a 0.8-second second paid step; either event can happen first. Each commitment costs one real magazine round and keeps the owned step variant. An interrupted first step earns no relay. Recovery extends from each commitment, with no refund. At most two paid steps per drill; no extra rounds, immunity or new input. Counts as your one capstone.
messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-ready-1.summa: Use one completed loading round to open a step while your burst is reserved.
messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-volley-1.summ: Finish a paid step and load three rounds to earn a brief second leg.
messages.ui.soldier.readyHelp: After the first real drill insertion, action 1 has a 1.2-second loaded opening. Spend one magazine round for the owned step when no ready burst follow-up is available; normal step recovery still applies. Stopping the drill keeps that short earned opening. Dodge, ordinary Reload and health damage clear it.
messages.ui.soldier.volleyHelp: Loaded openings may be spent during step recovery. Once per drill, finishing the first paid step and inserting three actual rounds earns a 0.8-second relay. The relay spends one more magazine round. Stopping early cannot manufacture the third insertion; a canceled first step earns no relay. Both paid steps keep the owned variant and extend its recovery.
messages.pathway.soldier-marksman-1.name: Marksman
messages.pathway.soldier-marksman-1.summary: Read the cover, choose an angle and spend a cartridge on one deliberate bank.
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-1.name: Bank Shot
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-1.description: Use action 1 to spend one magazine round on a 30-base-damage shot that reflects from one masonry face or closed gate. Read the angle: real bodies can stop the first leg and a further wall stops the bank. The projectile travels at 900 pixels per second for at most 1.6 seconds, with 8-second base recovery. No burst opening is needed. Ordinary Reload, dodge or channeling prevents a fresh shot. No auto-aim, immunity, free ammunition or boss-core bypass. Choose this firing discipline instead of Skirmisher; your issued rally, burst and Last Roll Call remain.
messages.ui.soldier.marksmanHelp: Bank Shot spends one magazine round on action 1. Aim into a masonry face to reflect once, or take a direct shot. Plan around real bodies and further cover. Ordinary Reload and dodge prevent a fresh cast; a rejected request spends no round or recovery. The shot adds no movement or immunity. Your rally, burst and Last Roll Call keep their own jobs.
messages.ui.soldier.pairHelp: Measured Pair uses action 2. Spend one round now; its first real cover bank earns 1.2 seconds for one manually aimed second press, spending another round. The second cannot earn another shot or refresh the window. Reload, dodge and channeling block a fresh shot without spending; missed or expired opportunities never refund the first round or recovery.
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-carom-1.name: Double Bank
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-carom-1.descripti: Carry Bank Shot through a second real masonry contact. Its original lifetime and travel budget stay finite; a third wall absorbs it. Choose this instead of Line Drive.
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-line-1.name: Line Drive
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-line-1.descriptio: After its first real bank, the shot can pass through one ordinary hostile body. Bosses, weak points and further cover still stop it. Bodies before the bank still intercept. Choose this instead of Double Bank.
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-pair-1.name: Measured Pair
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-pair-1.descriptio: Action 2 spends one actual round on a bank shot and starts twelve seconds of recovery. Its first real cover contact earns 1.2 seconds to manually aim and spend one further round with action 2. At most two shots; the second cannot earn another. Both inherit your chosen bank variant.
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-reserve-1.name: Held Measure
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-reserve-1.descrip: After Measured Pair earns its second shot, begin one real manual Reload to keep that opportunity through the reload and 0.6 seconds afterward, at most four seconds total. It cannot be reserved twice. Dodge, channel, overdrive, weapon or technique loss cancels the reserved opportunity. The normal reload still takes its full time; no extra rounds are created.
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-relay-1.name: Angle Relay
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-relay-1.descripti: Only the second paid Measured Pair shot's first real cover bank earns 0.8 seconds for one paid Bank Shot during its recovery. Spend one real round and extend, rather than reset, the existing Bank Shot recovery. An ordinary ready shot consumes the same opportunity. No automatic shot or recursive proof.
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-twin-1.name: Twin Lanes
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-twin-1.descriptio: When using an earned Angle Relay during Bank Shot recovery, spend two actual rounds to fire two physical bank shots ten degrees to either side of your manual aim. Both inherit your chosen bank variant and use real cover, bodies, travel and armor. Both projectile slots must fit or nothing is spent. One release consumes the relay and extends recovery; neither shot earns another opportunity. Ordinary ready Bank Shot remains one round.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-1.name: Grenadier
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-1.summary: Cooked Canister: Prepare, cook and manually throw one finite canister.
messages.ui.grenadier.help: Action 1 prepares a single live canister; press again to throw. A held primary trigger stays blocked; release and press it again to cancel the live hand. Fuse time keeps running while you cook and throw. Holding to expiry safely vents it; the spent recovery remains. Action 2 later adds short casts and grounded handling. Your rally, burst and Last Roll Call keep their own effects.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-1.name: Cooked Canister
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-1.description: Press action 1 to prepare one canister and start ten-second base recovery. Press again to throw along your manual aim. Its 2.4-second fuse keeps running while held or moving; holding to expiry safely vents the canister and spends the recovery. A normal cast starts at 650 pixels/second, slows on the floor, and stops at bodies or cover before its 90-pixel, 80-base-damage blast. Cover and source-sensitive armor apply. A live hand blocks primary fire until you throw or cancel; firing, Reload, dodge, actual health loss, burst or overdrive interrupts it. No friendly damage, ammunition refill or extra resource. Choose this discipline instead of Skirmisher or Marksman.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-skim-1.name: Skimming Case
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-skim-1.descripti: The thrown canister banks once from real fixed cover, retaining the unused portion of that tick and eighty percent of its speed. A further wall or a body grounds it; the same finite fuse continues. Excludes Contact Case.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-skim-1.summary: Skimming Case: One real bank, same fuse.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-contact-1.name: Contact Case
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-contact-1.descri: A thrown canister bursts on its first physical body or cover contact instead of waiting on the floor. It cannot bank, seek a target or pass cover. Manual cooking still sets how long it can travel before the fuse expires. Excludes Skimming Case.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-contact-1.summ: Contact Case: Burst at physical contact.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-pitch-1.name: Underhand Cast
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-pitch-1.descript: Action 2 makes a short cast at 280 pixels/second. It can release the canister already in your hand, or prepare and cast a fresh one in a single press if the same recovery is ready. Floor drag, bodies, cover and the actual remaining fuse still apply; no second stock or recovery is created.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-pitch-1.summar: Underhand Cast: A shorter throw on the same recovery.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-pin-1.name: Re-pin Drill
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-pin-1.descriptio: One Reload press may re-pin a live hand canister for at most four seconds, freeing the hand. The remaining fuse is stored exactly, never rewound. Action 1 resumes that same canister; it may not be re-pinned twice, including after a later catch. Ordinary magazine reload is separate. Excludes Clipped Sling; this preparation choice is optional before Toe Roll.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-pin-1.summary: Re-pin Drill: One bounded stored fuse.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-sling-1.name: Clipped Sling
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-sling-1.descript: Keep the live hand canister while using your issued Precision Burst and its owned General transformations. Its fuse keeps running; this grants no burst damage, free ammo or recovery. Primary fire, ordinary Reload, dodge, health loss and overdrive still interrupt it. Excludes Re-pin Drill; this offensive timing choice is optional before Toe Roll.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-sling-1.summar: Clipped Sling: Keep cooking through your issued burst.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-kick-1.name: Toe Roll
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-kick-1.descripti: Action 2 near your own grounded canister kicks that actual object along manual aim at 420 pixels/second. You must be within 48 pixels with a clear path. One kick per canister; its remaining fuse, casing choice and spent recovery stay exact. A nearby eligible grounded canister takes priority over a fresh short cast. No teleport, new charge, targeting or fuse refresh.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-kick-1.summary: Toe Roll: Approach and kick your actual grounded canister.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-return-1.name: Live Return
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-return-1.descrip: Action 1 can catch your own grounded canister within 48 clear pixels when at least 0.2 seconds of fuse remains. It returns the same object to your hand for another manually aimed throw. One catch per canister; its remaining fuse, spent kick/re-pin rights, casing and recovery are retained. Pool rejection cannot eat the held charge. No new explosive, stock or rewound clock.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-return-1.summa: Live Return: Catch the same object once; no clock reset.
messages.pathway.soldier-sniper-1.name: Sniper
messages.pathway.soldier-sniper-1.summary: Settled Shot: Plant, settle and deliberately release one actual round.
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-1.name: Settled Shot
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-1.description: Action 1 reserves one actual magazine round and starts ten-second base recovery. Stand still for 0.7 seconds, then press action 1 again to fire a manually aimed, direct 110-base-damage physical shot. Preparation lasts at most three seconds and never fires automatically. Turning more than twelve degrees from the settled bearing recenters the sight and restarts settling within the original deadline. Movement, a new primary press, Reload, dodge, health loss, burst or overdrive cancels the paid preparation without refund. A held primary stays blocked through preparation; release and press it again to cancel. Let an already committed burst finish before preparing. Cover, bodies, travel and source armor apply; no bank, piercing, targeting or immunity. Choose this discipline instead of Skirmisher, Marksman or Grenadier.
messages.ui.sniper.help: Action 1 reserves one actual round and starts recovery. Stand still while the sight settles, then press again when you choose to fire. Turning more than twelve degrees from the settled bearing recenters the sight and restarts settling within the original three-second preparation. Movement, Reload, dodge, health loss, burst or overdrive abandons the paid round. A held primary stays blocked; release and press it again to cancel. Let an already committed burst finish before preparing. Your rally, burst and Last Roll Call keep their own effects.
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-carry-1.name: Careful Carry
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-carry-1.description: Movement can carry the same paid Settled Shot round within its original three-second preparation. Every actual displacement moves the sight to your current position, recenters its bearing and restarts the full0.7-second settle. Stop and settle before separately releasing; there is no moving release, extra speed, protection or deadline extension. Fresh preparation still requires a planted body. Reload, dodge, actual health loss, channel, burst, overdrive or a new primary press after release still abandons the round. Choose this handling instead of Clear Chamber.
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-clear-1.name: Clear Chamber
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-clear-1.description: During valid Settled Shot preparation, press Reload to return exactly its one reserved round into available magazine space. This cancels preparation and keeps the spent recovery; that press clears the chamber rather than starting an ordinary reload. A full magazine rejects the clear and preserves the paid preparation and original deadline. A later Reload without preparation works normally. Firing, expiry, movement or another interruption returns nothing. Choose this handling instead of Careful Carry.
messages.ui.sniper.carryHelp: Action 1 reserves one actual round and starts recovery. With Careful Carry you can relocate the paid round, but every actual movement recenters the sight and restarts the full0.7-second settle. Stop and settle before manual release; the original three-second deadline never extends. Aim beyond twelve degrees also recenters. Reload, dodge, actual health loss, channel, burst, overdrive or a new primary press after release abandons the round. A held primary stays blocked. Your rally, burst and Last Roll Call keep their own effects.
messages.ui.sniper.clearHelp: Action 1 reserves one actual round and starts recovery. Stand still, settle and separately press again to fire; aim beyond twelve degrees recenters within the original three-second deadline. With Clear Chamber, Reload returns exactly the reserved round into available magazine space, cancels preparation and keeps recovery. That press clears rather than ordinarily reloads; a full magazine rejects the clear while preserving preparation/deadline. A later Reload works normally. Movement, dodge, actual health loss, channel, burst, overdrive or a new primary press after release still abandons the round. A held primary stays blocked. Your rally, burst and Last Roll Call keep their own effects.
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-bore-1.name: Bore Through
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-bore-1.description: After preparing and settling Settled Shot, action 2 releases the same paid round with70base ability impact instead of110. It may cross one narrow cover section, at most68pixels along its actual path including the round's width, then retains sixty percent impact. Travel inside cover consumes real time and lifespan; deeper masonry, another solid or the first body stops it. Armor uses your actual firing origin. This is no body piercing, bank, targeting or armor bypass. It cannot prepare a fresh round, extend the original opportunity, return ammunition or reset recovery. Action 1 keeps its direct shot. Careful Carry and Clear Chamber remain optional handling choices.
messages.ui.sniper.boreHelp: Bore Through uses action 2 to release the already settled round through one narrow cover section at reduced impact. Prepare with action 1 first. Real travel continues inside cover; deeper masonry, another solid and the first body stop the shot. Action 1 retains its direct shot, and the original preparation deadline/recovery still apply.
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-rest-1.name: Field Rest
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-rest-1.description: With no paid round prepared, action2 sets an empty rest at your actual position and bearing. Remain planted for0.7seconds; moving, taking health loss or another action interrupts unfinished setup. Once settled you may leave, but the rest stays fixed and expires9seconds after planting. Return within6pixels and12degrees: an accepted fresh action1 consumes the rest and reserves one actual round ready for a separate manual release. Normal recovery and actual ammunition still apply; unavailable preparation preserves the rest. Elsewhere action1 retains its ordinary full settling. Action2 recalls an existing empty rest, or uses Bore Through when a paid round is prepared. Carry movement restarts settling; Clear returns only the paid round, never the rest. No automatic shot, targeting, remote origin, cover, protection, extra ammunition or new currency.
messages.ui.sniper.restHelp: With no paid preparation, action2 sets an empty Field Rest or recalls an existing one. Stand still and settle it for0.7s; it stays fixed for9s from planting. You may then leave and return within6px/12degrees. A fresh accepted action1 consumes the rest and pays for one round ready for a separate manual release; recovery and actual ammunition still apply. If preparation is unavailable, the rest stays. Elsewhere action1 settles normally. With a paid preparation, action2 remains Bore Through. Carry movement restarts settling; Clear never restores the rest.
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-withdrawal-1.name: Prepared Withdrawal
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-withdrawal-1.descri: Prepare two separate Field Rest positions at least96pixels apart, each with its real settling, manual bearing and original expiry. Both must be settled before a normally available action1 claims the first. Only a successful separate manual release earns one return opportunity at the other original site. Physically return within its local position/bearing limits: action1 may reserve another actual round during recovery, ready for its own separate manual release. That alternate payment extends spent recovery by one ordinary action1 duration. A normally ready claim consumes the same finite opportunity. With no paid preparation, action2 sets a second site only after the first settles and from sufficient distance; nearer action2, two sites or an armed return means recall the plan. Carry still requires new settling after movement; Clear returns only its reserved round and keeps recovery. No site, right or ammunition is restored and a return cannot earn another return. Physical bodies, cover, time and firing-origin armor remain.
messages.ui.sniper.withdrawalBoreName: Field Rest / Prepared Withdrawal / Bore Through
messages.ui.sniper.withdrawalHelp: Settle both positions before the first normally available action1 claim. That round must actually be released before one return can be paid for at the other original site during recovery. Recovery extends; the original site expiry keeps running. With no paid preparation, action2 sets a second site only after the first settles and from at least96px away; nearer action2, two sites or an armed return means recall. Carry and Clear retain their issued handling.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-1.name: Flak Gunner
messages.ui.heavy.manualHelp: Choose where to interrupt an incoming lane. Ordinary gunfire, Braced Firing and Suppressing Cone keep their own roles.
messages.ui.heavy.flakHelp: Action 1 spends one magazine round to launch a defensive flak shell. It clears at most three small hostile shots only when it bursts, with cover blocking. It deals no body damage and cannot clear large objects, beams, fields or ground attacks. Moving and bracing are allowed; busy or empty rejection spends nothing.
messages.ui.heavy.commandHelp: Action 2 commands your one actual flying shell before its original fuse ends. It cannot act on the launch moment, add another shell or reset recovery. The burst uses nearby shots after they move.
messages.skill.heavy-flak-1.name: Flak Round
messages.skill.heavy-flak-1.description: Spend one magazine round to launch a defensive flak shell along your manual aim. Its 0.6-second fuse or first body/cover contact makes one burst at its actual position. After nearby shots move, the 45-pixel burst clears at most three small hostile projectiles with clear line of sight. It deals no body damage and cannot clear large objects, beams, fields or ground attacks. Protection begins only at the burst; earlier hits remain. Moving and Braced Firing are allowed. Reloading, dodging, channeling, overdrive, empty ammunition or a full projectile pool rejects launch without payment. Ordinary primary pauses for the launch. Base recovery is eight seconds.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-1.summary: Place one delayed defensive burst with an actual magazine round.
messages.skill.heavy-flak-compact-1.name: Close Pattern
messages.skill.heavy-flak-compact-1.description: Fit a shorter 0.4-second fuse and a 60-pixel all-around burst. It reaches less distant ground before bursting, but covers every bearing. One magazine round, at most three small hostile shots and the same recovery; real bodies and cover still stop the shell. Choose this fitting instead of Forward Baffle.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-compact-1.summary: A shorter flight and wider all-around burst.
messages.skill.heavy-flak-frontal-1.name: Forward Baffle
messages.skill.heavy-flak-frontal-1.description: Fit a longer 0.8-second fuse and a 90-pixel forward burst within a 70-degree fan. The fan keeps the original firing bearing and leaves a real rear gap. One magazine round, at most three small hostile shots and the same recovery; real bodies and cover still stop the shell. Choose this fitting instead of Close Pattern.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-frontal-1.summary: Reach farther forward with a real rear gap.
messages.skill.heavy-flak-command-1.name: Manual Fuze
messages.skill.heavy-flak-command-1.description: Use action 2 to burst your one actual flying flak shell at its present position. Command it before the original fuse ends; the burst still waits until nearby shots have moved. It cannot act on the launch moment, create another shell or burst, return ammunition or reset recovery. Busy hands reject the command while the original flight and fuse continue. Without a live own shell there is no action to command. Both optional burst fittings retain their actual geometry.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-command-1.summary: Choose when the one actual flying shell bursts.
messages.skill.heavy-flak-running-1.name: Running Fuze
messages.skill.heavy-flak-running-1.description: Change your first Action 2 command into one early interception pulse while the same paid shell keeps flying. That pulse may clear at most one actual small hostile shot. The original fuse or first body/cover contact later makes the final pulse, using only the unspent part of the original combined three-shot allowance. An empty early pulse uses no interception allowance, but the command is still spent. You cannot command that shell again. No new round, extra carrier, extended fuse or recovery reset. Choose this handling instead of Hanging Fuze; omitting both keeps the original immediate three-shot Manual Fuze.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-running-1.summary: One early interception, then the same shell carries the unspent allowance onward.
messages.skill.heavy-flak-hanging-1.name: Hanging Fuze
messages.skill.heavy-flak-hanging-1.description: Your first Action 2 command arrests the actual shell at its current air position and firing bearing. It does not burst on that command or extend its original fuse. A separate later Action 2 can burst the same shell there; its original fuse or an actual enemy body contact can still end it. The one burst retains the original three-small-shot allowance and real cover. Busy rejection keeps the arrested shell and original deadline. No teleport, attachment, extra round, persistent mine, refund or recovery reset. Choose this handling instead of Running Fuze; omitting both keeps the original immediate Manual Fuze.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-hanging-1.summary: Arrest the actual shell, then choose a separate burst before its original fuse.
messages.skill.heavy-flak-seam-1.name: Seam Fuze
messages.skill.heavy-flak-seam-1.description: While your paid flak shell is still live, press Action 1 again to cut its flight and clear a thin seam along the ground it actually crossed. The seam reaches 9 pixels to either side and uses only the unspent part of that shell’s original three-small-shot allowance. Action 2 keeps your acquired point-burst operation, so choose a narrow line behind the shell or a wider burst at it. Running Fuze spends from the same allowance; Hanging Fuze retains only the line laid before arrest. Real cover crossing that line permanently severs it for this shell, leaving Action 2 and the original fuse available. Cut before the original fuse ends. Busy hands reject without cutting. No extra round, body damage, shield, recovery reset or lingering trap.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-seam-1.summary: Cut the shell’s travelled line, or keep its wider point burst.
messages.ui.heavy.seamHelp: Action 1 launches the round; a separate Action 1 before its fuse cuts the narrow line already travelled. Action 2 keeps its point operation. New cover can sever the line for this shell. A cut shares the original allowance and adds no ammunition cost. The controls below show your current bindings.
